name: Generate images of DWI overlaid on T1
summary: Generates a PNG of the brain-extracted b0 of a DWI overlaid on a T1-weighted image with FSLeyes, to check DWI-to-T1 registration.
description: Extracts and averages the b0 volumes of the DWI (select_dwi_vols), brain-extracts them with FSL bet, and renders the b0 (red-yellow) and its mask outline on the T1 with fsleyes render, writing raw/out.png. The DWI and T1 must already be registered to each other. Use it to check DWI-T1 alignment or make figures.

inputs.description: DWI image with bvals (bvals are used to select the b0 volumes).
inputs.requirements: Must already be aligned to the T1.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image used as the background.

outputs.description: Directory with out.png showing the DWI b0 and its brain mask outline overlaid on the T1.
